findings.issue_summary: Accessibility setup lacks prominent data-use disclosure and affirmative consent
findings.evidence: YouTubeAccessibilityGuideDialog.kt:42-83 explains restricted-settings bypass and enabling service, but does not explain event/package data access, processing or sharing, and :109-116 opens Accessibility Settings without affirmative data-use consent. XML :6 enables canRetrieveWindowContent=true despite service :14-26 using only packageName for deterministic YouTube launch detection. isAccessibilityTool is absent. No screen-text or keystroke collection/upload observed.
findings.recommendation: Prefer manual operation or narrower API. If keeping the deterministic listener, disable window-content retrieval, provide separate prominent disclosure of package/window-event access and local use/sharing, require explicit consent before settings navigation, and complete the Play Accessibility declaration and listing disclosure. Do not mark this general wellness utility as a disability accessibility tool.

findings.issue_summary: YouTube listener starts camera FGS from background without a demonstrated while-in-use exemption
findings.evidence: YouTubeDetectionAccessibilityService.kt:21-26 invokes startForegroundService directly on package detection. Manifest :173-176 declares camera type. EyeExerciseOverlayService.kt:299-304 starts foreground notification then camera. AccessibilityService's background-start allowance does not itself establish the separate camera while-in-use exemption; this event-triggered path has no visible activity/user notification interaction.
findings.recommendation: Replace automatic camera startup with a user-visible prompt that opens the app; start a session from its visible Activity with CAMERA granted. Verify both background-start and camera while-in-use requirements independently and handle denial/revocation without crash.

findings.issue_summary: Play Console camera foreground-service declaration remains to be confirmed
findings.evidence: Manifest declares FOREGROUND_SERVICE and FOREGROUND_SERVICE_CAMERA plus android:foregroundServiceType=camera. EyeExerciseOverlayService.kt:324-351 creates a low-importance channel and user-facing ongoing notification and calls startForeground. Gradle targetSdk=35. Type aligns with camera eye analysis; no missing type or specialUse property issue found. Play Console declarations cannot be verified from source.
findings.recommendation: Complete/verify camera FGS declaration in Play Console including core benefit, user initiation/stopping behavior and functional demonstration video; test notification visibility and stop controls on supported releases.
